Whenever the Telepathic Pentacle takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the Telepathic Pentacle dies. At the end of its turn, it grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire damage since its last turn. The Telepathic Pentacle regains 10 hit points for each head regrown in this way.

traits.name: Reactive Heads

traits.name: Wakeful

actions.name: Multiattack

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Vellynne is an 8th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following wizard spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Chill Touch|chill touch]] (see "Actions" below), [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Message|message]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Comprehend Languages|comprehend languages]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Ray Of Sickness|ray of sickness]], [[Tools/Spells/Tasha'S Hideous Laughter|Tasha's hideous laughter]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Darkvision|darkvision]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]], [[Tools/Spells/Ray Of Enfeeblement|ray of enfeeblement]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Animate Dead|animate dead]], [[Tools/Spells/Leomund'S Tiny Hut|Leomund's tiny hut]], [[Tools/Spells/Vampiric Touch|vampiric touch]] (see "Actions" below)
- **4th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Arcane Eye|arcane eye]], [[Tools/Spells/Blight|blight]]

actions.name: Vampiric Touch (3rd-Level Spell; Requires a Spell Slot)
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, and Vellynne regains hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt. If Vellynne casts this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the necrotic damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

actions.name: Chill Touch (Cantrip)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d8) necrotic damage, and the target can't regain hit points until the start of Vellynne's next turn.

actions.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
actions.desc: While holding this wand, Vellynne can expend 1 or more of its 7 charges to cast the [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|magic missile]] spell from it. She can expend 1 charge to cast the 1st-level version of the spell. She can increase the spell slot level by one for each additional charge she expends. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If the wand's last charge is expended, roll a d20; on a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.
